name: Liam Evans
source:
He is a sexy young man who belongs to the Crown, a royal commissioned unit under the direct control of the Queen.

In between his duties, he is a stage actor.

He charms everyone, but sometimes seems to have a lonely profile.

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Alice in Wonderland's Cheshire Cat

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#liam]official website[/url]]
